withheld.criticalPositions: Career cannot list this organization's critical positions. Position criticality belongs to the organization structure, and there is no filter to ask with. Career shows the succession plans it holds.
withheld.developmentMix: The 70-20-10 development mix is counted and never validated. No balance rule was specified, so this product states none.
withheld.evidenceDocument: A readiness assessment cites no document. There is nowhere to keep the reference, and no file storage exists.
withheld.mobilityExpiry: Nothing expires a recommendation. Its standing is worked out from its own dates on the day you ask.
withheld.ninebox: Career shows no nine-box placement or potential band. Performance owns those, and reading them here would not be bounded.
withheld.recommendationsOnly: Nothing in Career changes an employment, a position or a salary. Accepting a recommendation records that somebody agreed with it.
withheld.scheduledReview: Nothing reminds anybody. A succession review comes due because somebody ran this query, not because anything fired.
withheld.selfService: Career cannot tell which employee or manager is signed in, so there is no 'my career plan' and no team view. An employment identifier in a request is a filter, never proof of identity.
